description: This file defines a templated class for managing an array of listener callbacks with fixed maximum size, along with associated types and functions for callback registration, invocation, and management. It appears to be part of an embedded firmware project, handling event listeners for various inputs.

classes.name: IntListenerArray
classes.description: A templated class managing an array of callback functions and their arguments, supporting registration, clearing, and invocation of callbacks.

methods.name: IntListenerArray
methods.description: Constructor initializing the listener array by clearing existing callbacks.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the current listener count and zeroes out callbacks and arguments arrays.

methods.name: registerCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback function with an optional argument; overload for different callback function signatures.

methods.name: invokeJustArgCallbacks
methods.description: Invokes all registered callbacks that take a void* argument.
